name: smwpatches-bounce-block-underwater-push
title: Bounce Block Underwater Push
description:
Normally, bounce blocks such as note blocks or ?-block don't push the player downwards underwater. This patch makes it so that when you're underwater and swimming with an item, you get pushed downwards a little like in Super Mario Maker.

Note that it is not compatible with Press X to Item Swim while patches like All Switch Blocks Have Powerups requires you to adjust some settings. It also doesn't affect custom blocks such as these either.

Requested by buckaroodle610.
